import cadquery as cq

FAMILY = 'custom'
OUTLINE = [(-25.842, 6.727), (-26.11, 3.806), (-25.843, 2.846), (-25.721, -0.459), (-26.004, -5.573), (-25.721, -6.981), (-25.047, -7.437), (24.24, -7.43), (24.917, -6.894), (25.3, -2.996), (25.933, -2.375), (25.966, -0.405), (25.568, -0.994), (25.445, -0.037), (25.605, 0.866), (25.89, 0.438), (26.107, 0.479), (25.976, 2.249), (25.795, 2.696), (25.313, 3.002), (25.045, 6.458), (24.821, 7.11), (24.383, 7.42), (-24.883, 7.444), (-25.52, 7.266)]
HOLES = []
SLOTS = []
BOSSES = []
MEASURE_MAP = {'thickness': 'thickness', 'side.thickness': 'thickness'}

PARAMS = {  # name: (default, min, max, step, unit, affects_fit, label)
    "thickness": (14.5, 0.80, 40.0, 0.01, "mm", True, "Plate thickness"),
    "outline_offset": (-0.7, -1.0, 1.0, 0.02, "mm", True, "Outline offset (+ grows the outline)"),
}


def build(p):
    t = p["thickness"]
    prof = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(OUTLINE).close()
    if abs(p["outline_offset"]) > 0.005:
        prof = prof.offset2D(p["outline_offset"], "intersection")
    body = prof.extrude(t)
    for i, c in enumerate(HOLES):
        d = p["hole_" + str(i + 1) + "_d"]
        cutter = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1).center(c[0], c[1]).circle(d / 2).extrude(t + 2)
        body = body.cut(cutter)
    for i, s in enumerate(SLOTS):
        sl, sw = p["slot_" + str(i + 1) + "_l"], p["slot_" + str(i + 1) + "_w"]
        cutter = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1).center(s[0], s[1]).slot2D(sl, sw, s[2]).extrude(t + 2)
        body = body.cut(cutter)
    if BOSSES:
        studs = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=t - 0.2).pushPoints(BOSSES).circle(p["boss_d"] / 2)
        body = body.union(studs.extrude(p["boss_h"] + 0.2))
    return body


result = build({k: v[0] for k, v in PARAMS.items()})
